# SP-01 bounded integrated regression and publication handoff

**Artifact ID:** SP01-P12-RESULT\
**Version/date:** 0.1 Draft · 28 October 2026\
**Status:** Bounded session regression/evidence handoff executed; owner local test reported OK; broader release gates remain open.\
**Inputs:** [FEAT-SP01-01](../../implementation/features/sp-01-session-foundation/plan.md) v0.9; [P12 task](../../implementation/features/sp-01-session-foundation/tasks/SP01-P12-regression-handoff.md) v0.8; [SP-01](../../../specs/001-session.md) v0.5; ADR-0024/0025 v0.5 Proposed; Workspace contract v0.2.10.\
**Trace:** SP-01.4 / M-01; AC-01/36/37/68, applicable TC-01/18/22; BR-01/10; SC-06 relevance without whole-source-protection acceptance.\
**Owner role:** Sequential implementer. No independent reviewer or Accepted ADR is claimed.

## Outcome and authority

The owner reports their local feature test is OK, authorises screenshots/recording for feature tests, and requests commit/push to the previously confirmed GitHub origin. This is local user feedback and publication authority, not approval of every security/deployment/ADR gate. The existing feature branch is retained; no merge to main is authorised or performed.

The session slice now has actual sign-in/server-derived context, strict configured idle/absolute expiry, current-token logout, mandatory atomic audit, fail-closed persistence/clock handling and real same-origin UI. This report consolidates the earlier P08–P11 implementation and negative evidence; earlier failed clock-guarantee/fixture/build attempts remain retained. No project/document capability or guarded protected-content send is implemented by a session.

## Exact integrated run

The [P12 run](sp01-p12-evidence/2026-10-28T05-31-31-505Z/result.json) records Node 24.22.1, actual commands, HEAD/branch, scoped dirty-diff digest, exact before/after hashes and stable runnable inputs. Source.zip preserves those inputs with verified entry digests. Documentation/context checks are separate prerequisites. No source update was made to make a failed assertion pass during this run.

| Command | Outcome |
| --- | --- |
| typecheck / build | Passed web and both services |

The last fresh lockfile installation is retained in the P11 final run; no dependencies changed afterwards. P12 does not run npm ci while a task-owned Vite process holds a Windows native-library lock. The committed sources and developer TLS instructions must remain sufficient to reconstruct the fixture; no private key or live connection secret is published.

## Assertion mapping

| Scope | Measured assertion | Limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC-01 | Actual cookie/current DB state determines the actor; forged actor/header/query inputs do not switch it | Later project/document authority is separate |

Node result counts include suite parents where noted in the detailed reports; they are not counts of distinct handlers or complete FR/SC cases. Actual public operations exercised are signIn/getSession/signOut. Contract, SQL and metadata results do not add protected-business-handler passes.

## Publication scope and checks

The authorised publication includes accumulated SP-01 preparation/decisions/plans, backend/frontend session code, additive migrations 005/006, exact dependency lockfile, tests, necessary shared contract/input/diagram metadata and retained evidence. Existing migrations 001–004 are not rewritten. Original failed results remain available rather than being deleted for publication.

Git staging uses an explicit reviewed path inventory. Private TLS material, local environment/config, node_modules/dist, Docker data and ignored scratch work are excluded; exact probe sources inside deliberate evidence archives are scanned separately.

The text/archive publication scan found no live private key or provider/GitHub token. Credential-URL matches resolve only to reviewed negative literals in session-runtime.test.ts (invalid operator/Knowledge URLs and rejected username/password origin), repeated in source snapshots. Synthetic fixtures/templates are distinguished from live credentials. This is a bounded publication scan, not a claim of a complete security audit.

Commit uses Codex identity with a Co-Authored-By byline. The owner-confirmed destination is https://github.com/900M100CK/scrum-workspace-KMS-ai.git on feature/sp-01-session-foundation; no force push or main merge is permitted. Actual commit/push outcome is reported after execution, not predeclared by this document.

D-07 current project/document guarded handoff, later protected business operations, full SC-06/TC-02, target-deployment KDF/clock/capacity, unobserved clock intervals, all-browser/accessibility/usability and independent review/release acceptance remain open. No development migration/reset or external real-data transfer occurred.

P12 closes only this bounded session regression/evidence handoff. SP-01/parent remains Draft with explicit limits; the next canonical feature is SP-02 under its own registered plan and authority decisions. Existing user test feedback does not grant new business scope or accept unrelated ADRs.

# SP-01 — testing and audit report

**Artifact ID:** SP01-TEST-AUDIT-01\
**Version/date:** 0.1 Draft · 1 November 2026\
**Status:** Consolidated measured evidence and reproducible testing guide; not an independent audit or release approval.\
**Inputs:** [SP-01](../../../specs/001-session.md) v0.5; [feature plan](../../implementation/features/sp-01-session-foundation/plan.md) v0.9; [original P12 result](SP-01-P12-handoff-2026-10-28.md) v0.1; [current integration result](SP-02-execution-2026-10-31.md) v0.2; Workspace v0.2.11; Proposed ADR-0024/0025/0026.\
**Trace:** AC-01/36/37/68; TC-01 and applicable TC-18/22 subsets; BR-01/10. Full SC-06 is outside the measured session subset.\
**Author:** Codex, sequential implementer/report author. Independent reviewer: not assigned.

## What exists

Workspace implements POST/GET/DELETE /session and the same-origin React sign-in/current-session/sign-out flow. The actor comes from the server cookie and current persisted account/session; request-supplied actor data grants nothing. Tokens are opaque, only token digests are persisted, and responses expose user_id/expires_at rather than credentials or tokens. Project/document authority remains a separate check on every protected operation.

The cookie is __Host-sacw-session, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/ and has no Domain. Mutations require the configured exact HTTPS Origin and X-SACW-Request: 1. GET renews only a still-valid session within its immutable absolute deadline; equality at expiry is expired. Logout commits revocation/audit before returning an empty 204 and clearing the cookie. Missing/invalid current authentication is 401; unavailable authority/storage/clock is 503.

Workspace owns the data and audit transaction. Audit failure rolls back the corresponding mutation. Unknown COMMIT acknowledgement is an unknown outcome, not proof of rollback or permission for an automatic retry. Account disable revokes existing sessions. An observed clock backstep latches a durable fault; independently attested private recovery invalidates old sessions. These mechanisms do not prove detection of an unobserved clock excursion or a protected-source socket handoff.

## Evidence and source identity

| Evidence | Observed result | Interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Original P12 run, 28 October](SP-01-P12-handoff-2026-10-28.md#exact-integrated-run) | Node 24.22.1; storage 17, HTTP 15, lifecycle 18, UI 10, foundation 19, storage/handoff 26, contracts 26 | Original measured session scope; retain its own archives, versions and browser observations |
| [1 November regression log](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/regression-attempt-1.log) | 89/89, zero skips: session suites 60 + same-transaction session tests 3 + storage/handoff 26 | Actual rerun under Node 24.21.0 after SP-02 integration; not 89 distinct permission behaviours |
| [Foundation final rerun](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/foundation-attempt-3.log) | 19/19, zero skips, including configured HTTPS | Framework/transport prerequisites, not full session acceptance |
| [Original browser evidence](SP-01-P12-handoff-2026-10-28.md#visual-evidence) | Keyboard login, authenticated reload, controlled expiry, logout | Manual observations, separate from simulated-cookie DOM tests |
| [Current isolated Edge summary](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/browser-summary.json) | Edge 156.0.4314.50; real HTTPS cookie login/reload/logout, no TLS bypass | Current SP-02 browser integration also exercises the session consumer; not a full repeat of the original session browser matrix |

The [current source manifest](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/source-manifest.json) and [verified archive](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/source-inputs.zip) retain 117 runnable inputs and 25 build-output hashes. The source capture was made on codex/sp-02-project-membership with parent HEAD 362831fbf6e342e81226195f56f9d697faa0a367; its worktree hashes, not that parent alone, identify the implementation tested. Original P12 archives identify the earlier baseline independently. The report does not relabel older tests as new executions.

At checkout, record git rev-parse HEAD and git log -1 -- services/workspace/src/session/store.ts alongside any reproduction result. The publication commit is resolved from Git history rather than embedded as a self-referential hash. A clean-clone/remote CI result is not claimed.

## Run the automated checks

Use Node 24+, the root lockfile installation (npm ci), Docker and the [local HTTPS setup](../../../apps/web/LOCAL-HTTPS.md). The public localhost certificate and private key must already exist locally; neither is committed. Browser trust is an explicit owner setup step. Follow [private session operations](../../../services/workspace/SESSION-OPERATIONS.md) and [HTTP configuration](../../../services/workspace/SESSION-HTTP.md) for manual application testing.

From the repository root:

```powershell
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm run test:session:storage
npm run test:session:http
npm run test:session:lifecycle
npm run test:session:ui
node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/workspace/session-transaction.test.mjs
```

The session/storage fixtures create uniquely named disposable databases and clean up only their own resources. Historical session/storage fixtures explicitly stop at Workspace 006; current SP-02 fixtures exercise the session checks through 008. Do not apply migrations to valuable development data, reset data, or remove Docker volumes as a testing shortcut.

For the HTTPS foundation check, set SACW_DEV_TLS_CERT and SACW_DEV_TLS_KEY to the existing local certificate/key paths before npm run test:foundation; without the opt-in configuration that older transport case may skip. A skipped case is not a browser or TLS pass.

## Manual test sheet

The following is a repeatable acceptance sheet for a tester; this consolidation turn did not perform a new manual run. Use synthetic accounts and an isolated environment, record actual outcomes, and never copy cookie/password values into the report.

| Case | Action | Expected observation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| S01 | Reload before sign-in | Checking state precedes sign-in; protected navigation is absent; unauthenticated GET /session is 401 |
| S02 | Submit a wrong password, then an unknown username | Same generic 401/message; neither identity creates a session; password input is cleared |
| S03 | Sign in with a provisioned enabled account using the keyboard | Server-confirmed actor/time; correctly scoped Secure/HttpOnly/Strict host-only cookie; no token/password in JSON or browser storage |
| S04 | Reload while authenticated and open Workspace | Cookie-backed current session is rechecked; current UI reconstructs from server state, not a saved bearer grant |
| S05 | Send an extra actor field or wrong/missing Origin/request header | Invalid shape 400 or mutation protection 403; no issued session/audit success; actor cannot switch |
| S06 | Use a missing/duplicate/forged/expired/revoked cookie | Generic 401; no protected subtree restored by a late response |
| S07 | Refresh before and at configured idle/absolute boundaries in the fixture | Only strictly unexpired sessions renew; absolute cap never moves; equality denies |
| S08 | Sign out, then reload or reuse the old token | Known revocation precedes 204/cookie clearing; old token denies; independent other sessions are unaffected |
| S09 | Disable the account through the private operator fixture | All its current sessions and fresh sign-in attempts deny; no public administrator bypass |
| S10 | Fail DB/audit/clock dependencies or lose a COMMIT acknowledgement in the fixture | Generic failure, hidden authenticated UI, no false success/automatic mutation retry; audit atomicity inspected in DB |
| S11 | Observe a clock backstep, then perform stale and valid attested recovery in the fixture | Durable fault survives restart; stale recovery rejects; successful recovery audits/revokes old sessions |

Use the automated lifecycle/persistence suites for precise concurrency and microsecond-boundary assertions; screenshots cannot prove those properties. The sign-out control, feedback focus, loading/error states and keyboard navigation should also be checked by a human.

## Audit navigation and open findings

| Concern | Primary inspection point |
| --- | --- |
| Current session/account/time, fault persistence, same-client reuse | services/workspace/src/session/store.ts; tests/workspace/persistence.test.mjs and session-transaction.test.mjs |
| Bounded transactions, rollback/discard, unknown commit | services/workspace/src/session/database.ts; persistence/lifecycle suites |
| KDF admission, parameter validation, dummy unknown-user work | services/workspace/src/session/kdf.ts; services/workspace/test/kdf.test.ts |
| Cookie/Origin/input/output/error handling | services/workspace/src/session/http.ts and schemas.ts; tests/workspace/http.test.mjs |
| Renewal/logout and real lock schedules | tests/workspace/lifecycle.test.mjs |
| UI state cancellation, expiry/reload/outage | apps/web/src/session.ts and App.tsx; tests/workspace/ui.test.mjs |
| Storage ownership and no destructive rollback | Workspace migrations 005/006; SESSION-OPERATIONS.md |

Audit status is bounded author evidence, not independent approval. Outstanding: formal detailed ADR/deployment acceptance, trusted-time and KDF/capacity calibration for the target environment, unobserved clock intervals, D-07 source-send/socket exclusion, full project/document/citation/AI SC-06, broader browser/accessibility/usability coverage and remote clean-clone CI. Registration/reset/MFA and automatic lockout are not selected features.

Failure history is retained in original P08–P12 reports and the current integration report. The current foundation run initially hit loopback EACCES and an obsolete unimplemented-project scaffold assertion; later authorised reruns corrected the environment/current-route expectation and passed. Those failures are not discarded.

**Checklist/handoff:** Source/evidence/command links checked during publication; measured and specified cases separated; no new runtime run or independent audit implied. Reproduce with the recorded source identity, attach a new dated result, and preserve the stated open gates.

## Publication validation

The owner authorises publication of the current related branch and these reports. [Publication checks](evidence/SP-01-SP-02-publication-2026-11-01/checks.json) record the documentation/context/contract checks and unchanged frozen implementation source identity. No application tests are relabelled as new runs in this report-authoring turn. Only reviewed synthetic logs/source/media are included; unrelated local work and TLS/environment material remain excluded. Exact publication SHA and remote success are resolved from Git history and the post-push verification, not predicted here.

Console-log whitespace is normalised in the published text files; commands, failures and outcomes are unchanged. [Pre-normalisation captured log bytes](evidence/SP-01-SP-02-publication-2026-11-01/captured-logs.zip) are retained separately, including the already documented synthetic-cookie redaction. Source/archive hashes refer to runnable inputs and remain unchanged.

# SP-02 — testing and audit report

**Artifact ID:** SP02-TEST-AUDIT-01\
**Version/date:** 0.1 Draft · 1 November 2026\
**Status:** Consolidated measured evidence and reproducible testing guide; not an independent audit or whole-release approval.\
**Inputs:** [SP-02](../../../specs/002-project-membership.md) v0.7; [feature plan](../../implementation/features/sp-02-project-membership/plan.md) v0.6; [execution result](SP-02-execution-2026-10-31.md) v0.2; [project runbook](../../../services/workspace/PROJECTS.md) v0.1; Workspace v0.2.11; Proposed ADR-0019/0026.\
**Trace:** AC-02/03/38/39; BR-01/10/14; bounded TC-02/18/22/24 observations. Optional FR-64 is not selected.\
**Author:** Codex, sequential implementer/report author. Independent reviewer: not assigned.

## What exists and why

Seven Workspace operations are implemented: createProject, getProject, listProjects, addMember, listMembers, removeMember and global/project getAllowedActions. The live workspace UI uses those actual same-origin APIs. It shows only current-member projects and minimal member IDs/descriptive roles/revisions; it exposes no email or global account directory. Role labels do not grant capabilities, and allowed-actions results advise the UI without authorising a later request.

Current server identity, enabled account/session, project membership and the exact required explicit capability are checked in the owning Workspace transaction. Unknown/nonmember project reads share the exact generic 404. Create requires separately provisioned global authority; creator receives initial membership-management authority without blanket project/document rights. Add/rejoin grants no old capability, restricted read or assignment.

Removal locks the project, protects the last effective enabled membership manager, invalidates all individual capabilities/read grants, clears current assignees with task revisions/audit, and commits the removal result atomically. Task states, positions, completed allocations/history and unrelated projects remain intact. Private explicit authority tooling is separate from browser roles; it can restore global create authority for another enabled account after revocation/disable without an automatic Admin or account re-enable.

## Verification already measured

The following results were observed on 1 November 2026, Node 24.21.0 and disposable pinned PostgreSQL 17.10/pgvector 0.8.2. This documentation/publication turn consolidates them; it does not invent a new run.

| Group | Actual result and boundary | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current SP-02 suite | 64/64, zero skips; cursor/controller unit tests, migration/operator SQL, actual HTTP/barrier and DOM/HTTPS assertions | [Log](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/projects.log) |
| Actual isolated Microsoft Edge | 1/1; real TLS/cookies, create/add, lost committed response and exact-key recovery after reload, removal clearing, keyboard confirmation/cancel, 390 px overflow and logout | [Summary](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/browser-summary.json), [successful log](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/browser-attempt-3.log) |
| Session + historical storage regression | 89/89, zero skips; historical Workspace 006 fixtures are labelled explicitly | [Log](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/regression-attempt-1.log) |
| Foundation with HTTPS | 19/19, zero skips | [Final rerun](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/foundation-attempt-3.log) |
| Typecheck/build | Passed web and both services | [Typecheck](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/typecheck.log), [build](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/build.log) |
| Context/docs/contracts prerequisites | 45/20/26; separate preparation schema suite 6/6 | [Final check summary](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/final-checks-summary.json), [preparation log](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/preparation-regression.log) |

Counts include parent cases and structural/SQL checks. They are not counts of distinct permission behaviours and do not close a whole TC or SC-06. See the [AC mapping](../requirement-verification.md#sp-02-bounded-runtime-observation--1-november-2026) and [execution report](SP-02-execution-2026-10-31.md) for failure history and limits.

The [source manifest](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/source-manifest.json) and [verified archive](evidence/SP-02-2026-11-01/source-inputs.zip) identify 117 runnable inputs and 25 build outputs. Capture parent HEAD was 362831fbf6e342e81226195f56f9d697faa0a367 on codex/sp-02-project-membership; exact dirty-worktree hashes identify the code tested. No environment/certificate/private-key file is archived. Resolve the publication commit with git rev-parse HEAD and git log -1 -- services/workspace/src/projects/store.ts after checkout; no clean-clone/remote CI result is claimed.

## Automated reproduction

Use Node 24+, npm ci from the root lockfile, running Docker and existing local TLS material from [the HTTPS guide](../../../apps/web/LOCAL-HTTPS.md). The tests create/clean up only their own uniquely named disposable resources. The development database was not upgraded during implementation.

```powershell
npm run typecheck
npm run build
npm run test:projects
```

The separate actual-browser gate uses an installed Playwright runner and Microsoft Edge. No new runner/browser is installed by the test. If the runner is not resolvable from the project, set SACW_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE to its existing index.mjs file URL (for example file:///C:/path/to/playwright/index.mjs). After the owner explicitly trusts the local certificate, run:

```powershell
$env:NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS = (Resolve-Path .tmp/local-https/localhost.crt).Path
npm run test:projects:browser
```

NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS trusts that public development certificate for the Node-side response-loss probe; TLS validation stays enabled. The test launches a separate Edge profile, never the personal profile. A missing runner, untrusted certificate or unavailable Docker fails explicitly rather than becoming a passing skip.

For manual local UI testing only, `node tests/workspace/project-browser-fixture.mjs` starts a disposable fixture and prints its origin and synthetic account name. The fixed synthetic password is documented in project-ui-fixture.mjs; it is never a real account. The fixture accepts state/stop on stdin and has a 15-minute cleanup deadline. Do not use its private fixture commands against the development database. General configuration/private provisioning/key setup is in [PROJECTS.md](../../../services/workspace/PROJECTS.md).

## Manual test sheet

These are repeatable cases for a tester, not newly executed checks in this report-authoring turn. Use synthetic A/B/C accounts, two projects and controlled fixture authority; record the source commit, actual status/body, relevant persisted rows/audits and screenshots without credentials or cookie values.

| Case | Action | Expected observation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| P01 | Compare A with and without explicit global create authority | Only explicit authority permits creation; missing authority 403; rejected attempt has no project/success audit |
| P02 | Create a project and reload | Stable server UUID/creator/time, revision 1, creator membership and explicit manager grant; current directory reconstructs it |
| P03 | Give equal descriptive roles different capabilities | Action controls differ by current explicit authority; role name alone cannot enable management |
| P04 | Read an unknown project and another user's project as a nonmember | Both 404 with exactly code:not_found and message:Resource unavailable; no extra fields |
| P05 | Add a known enabled account as developer/viewer | 201 minimal Member with actual revision; no email/directory, automatic capability or restricted read; unknown target generic 404 |
| P06 | Remove and rejoin the same account | Membership revision/generation advances; old grants/read/assignment stay invalid; a stale old removal revision conflicts |
| P07 | Remove the final effective manager, including two managers deleting concurrently | Conflict leaves state unchanged; serialised concurrent requests cannot leave zero effective managers |
| P08 | Remove a member assigned Backlog and completed-location tasks with historical allocations | Current assignees clear; task revisions/audits change atomically; state/order/allocations/history and other projects stay |
| P09 | Force business-audit or result-storage failure | All membership/grant/task/project effects roll back; generic failure, no success response |
| P10 | Drop a committed create/add/remove response, reload and check original operation | Same operation/key/body/precondition; no second mutation; UI never substitutes a fresh automatic key |
| P11 | Retry an original add after remove/rejoin changed the role/revision | Original minimal 201 snapshot, not current-state reconstruction; UI separately refreshes current state |
| P12 | Lose authority before replay or refresh | Current permission checks deny disclosure; old UI records/actions clear; permission denial does not prove an earlier uncertain result rolled back |
| P13 | Page projects/members, then tamper, switch actor/limit, change membership/projection or sign in again | Invalid/foreign 400; verified stale/expired 409; revoked project generic 404; same-actor relogin alone does not invalidate a cursor |
| P14 | Remove/misconfigure the cursor key or fail DB/authority | Missing key/dependency 503, malformed server configuration rejects startup; no empty/unrestricted fallback; rotation invalidates old tokens with 400 |
| P15 | Use removal with revision at/over the safe numeric limit in a controlled fixture | Controlled conflict without partial effects; no raw DB 500/error detail |
| P16 | Use only keyboard, reload, narrow layout and dependency outage | Accessible labels/feedback, explicit removal confirmation, current server reconstruction and no stale protected pane after failure/removal |

Exact wire media/body/extra-field negatives and final output corruption tests live in project-http.test.mjs. Use its real assertions instead of treating a successful schema validator as proof of permission enforcement.

## Audit map and deliberate trade-offs

| Concern | Source and invariant |
| --- | --- |
| Same-client authority and current state | projects/store.ts reuses session inspectInTransaction; shared clock/account/session before optional target/project locks; guards after relevant waits |
| Private bootstrap/recovery | projects/operator.ts and cli.ts; operator DB identity, explicit revision/reason, co-committed private audit, no public bootstrap |
| 007 safety | Immutable creator/time; private authority/audit; safe Project/Membership/Task revision bounds; legacy refusal; nonempty down refusal; SP-01 clock/session/audit untouched |
| Separate 008 safety | Existing idempotency store extended; no second receipt store or cursor table; legacy unknown project outcomes refuse; permanent consumed identity/result; nonempty down refusal |
| Minimal replay | outcomes.ts; actor/operation/key/hash/current-authority binding; original 201 Project/Member snapshot; 204 has no snapshot |
| Paging | cursor.ts/store.ts; keyed digest of the complete authorised projection/generations and actor/route/scope/limit/expiry; never session identity |
| HTTP disclosure | http.ts; exact generic denied/unknown reads, strict input and final serializer, no-store and bounded public errors |
| UI recovery | projects.ts/ProjectWorkspace.tsx; one actor-bound pending request in tab session storage before send; no password/token/fetched protected list; explicit sign-out clears it |

Paths above are under services/workspace/src/projects unless otherwise identified. Full projection hashing costs a complete eligible read per page and is unbenchmarked. A single kid/key is selected; no old-key ring is implemented. Current replay semantics intentionally retain original project name/description indefinitely; a different retention/deletion contract needs a separate decision.

Actual two-manager and private-provisioning races were measured. Assignment/read-grant writers in P07 are explicitly controlled SQL protocol doubles; actual SP-04 setAssignee and SP-06 document-grant handler races must be rerun as SP02-F01. Locks establish database decision ordering, not D-07 exclusion through socket/source handoff.
